chapter.verse: “Note na kipuk loh nadingun hih thu kong genkhol hi.
Amau in kikhopna innsung pan note hong hawlkhia ding uh hi. Ahi hi; hong that mite khempeuh in Pasian’ na ka sem hi ci-in a ki-um ding uh hi.
Amaute in ka Pa thei loin kei zong hong thei lo uh ahih ciangin, tua thu a bawl ding uh hi.

Amau hun a tun’ ciangin kong gensa hih thute na phawk kik nadingun tu-in kong genkhol hi.” “Acil panin hih thute note kiangah kong gen ngei kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note tawh keimah ka omkhawm lai hi.
Ahih hangin tu-inah kei hong sawlpa kiangah pai ding ka hih ciangin, ‘Koi lai-ah pai ding na hi hiam?’ ci-in note lakah kuamah in nong dong kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin hih thute note kiangah kong gen ciangin, note lungsung uh dahna tawh a kidim zo hi.

Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kei ka ciah leh, note’ ading a pha zaw ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kei ka ciah kei leh, Huhpa in note kiangah hong pai lo ding hi. Ahih hangin ka ciah leh, tua pa note kiangah kong sawl ding hi.
A hong tun’ ciangin, mawhna, siangthona leh thukhenna leitung mite kiangah a pulak ding hi.
Amau in kei hong um lo uh ahih ciangin, a mawhna uh a pulak ding hi.
Pa kiangah kei ciah ding a, note in kei hong mu nawn lo ding na hih uh ciangin, sian’thona a pulak ding hi.
Hih leitung ukpa in thukhenna thuak zo ahih ciangin, thukhenna a pulak ding hi.”
“Note kiangah gen ding thu tampi a om hangin tu-in na sang zo kei ding uh hi.

Ahih hangin thuman thutak Kha Siangtho hong tun’ ciangin, thuman thutak a vekpi-in note hong hilh ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama ut bang hong gen ahi kei hi, a zaksa thu khempeuh hong gen ding hi. Anung ciangin hong piang ding thu khempeuh zong hong hilh ding hi.
Amah in keima minthan’na hong langsak ding hi, bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima’ aa la-in note kiangah hong gen ding hi.
Ka Pa’ neihsa khempeuh keima’ aa ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin, keima’ aa la-in note kiangah a hong gen ding hi kong ci hi.”
“Tawlkhat khit ciangin nong mu kei ding uh hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu kik ding uh hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin, a nungzuite kimkhat in, “Tawlkhat khit ciangin nong mu kei ding uh hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu kik ding uh hi,’ leh ‘Pa kiangah ka pai man-inah, a cihna in bang thu ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kici uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, “Tawlkhat khit ciangin,’ a cihna in bang ahi hiam? Bang a cihnopna hiam ka thei kei uh hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.

Amaute in a dot nop uh Zeisu in a theih ciangin, “Tawlkhat khit ciangin note in kei nong mu nawn kei ding uh hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin, note in kei nong mu kik ding uh hi ka cihna thu note na kidong tek uh hiam?
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, note kapin na kiko ding uh hi. Leitung mite ahih leh, a lungdam ding uh hi. Note na dah ding uh hangin, na dahna uh lungdamna a suak ding hi.
Numei in ta a suah lai takin a hun tung ahih ciangin a dah hi. Ahih hangin ta a suah khit ciangin leitungah mi khat suak ahih ciangin lungdam a, a gimna a phawk nawn kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na dah uh hangin a nung ciangin keimah in note kong mukik ding a, no na lungdam ding uh hi. Note lungdamna kuamah in hong sut zo kei ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin kei kiangah bangmah nong dong kei ding uh hi. Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, note in keima min tawh Pa kiangah thu na nget khempeuh uh a hong pia ding hi.
Tudongin ka min suangin bangmah na ngen kei uh hi. Na lungdamna uh a kicin’ nadingin ngen un, na ngah ding uh hi.”
“Tua thute thugentehna tawh kong gen zo hi. Thugentehna tawh gen loin, Pa’ thu note kiangah a tel takin kong gen nading ahun hong tung ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin note in ka min suangin thu na ngen ding uh hi; note ading Pa kiangah ke’n ngen ning ka ci kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in kei nong it uh a, Pa kiang pan kong pai hi cih um na hih uh ciangin, Pa in zong note hong it ding hi.
Keimah in Pa kiang pan pusuakin leitungah kong kumsuk a; khatvei leitung pan pusuakin Pa kiangah ka pai kik ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
A nungzuite in, “Tu-in thugentehna zang loin a tel takpi-in nong gen hi!
Na khempeuh na thei khin a, kuamah in nang hong dot nading thu a om kei hi ci-in tu-in ka thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in Pasian’ kiang pan hong pai na hi ci-in ka um uh hi.” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in zong, “Tu-in nong um uh hiam?
En un, note in na omna ciat uhah na kikhenthang ding uh a, kei guak na hong nusiat nading uh ahun hong tung ding a, a tung zo hi. Ahih hangin kei guak ka om kei hi; Pa in kei tawh a omkhawm hi.
Note in keima sungah nopna na neih nadingun hih thute kong genkhol hi. Note in leitungah gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Ahih hangin lunghimawh kei un, leitung ka zozo hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
